_meta.name: Formulynx SerpAPI Market Trends Batch Config
_meta.description: Master configuration for monthly SerpAPI batch fetching. Contains all ingredients (modern + Ayurvedic/natural), brands, benefits, product formats, and query generation rules. V2 adds 45+ Ayurvedic/natural ingredients, 13 additional brands, Hindi search terms, traditional formulations, and Ayurvedic comparison groups.
_meta.notes: SerpAPI Basic Plan = $50/5000 searches. We use ~1250/month = well within budget with 3750 remaining for on-demand.

batch_job_config.schedule_description: 1st of every month at 2:00 AM IST
batch_job_config.on_demand_auto_add_description: If an on-demand query is triggered 3+ times in a month, auto-add to master batch list

ingredients._description: Master ingredient database. Each ingredient has metadata for query generation and matching.

product_formats._description: All product formats with their search terms and applicable categories

benefits._description: Benefit/claim terms for Level 2 (Competing Approaches) trend queries

query_generation_rules._description: Rules for generating SerpAPI batch queries from the master data above

level_1_ingredient_queries.description: Ingredient × Format combinations. Generate '{ingredient_search_term} {format_search_term}' for compatible formats only.
level_1_ingredient_queries.hindi_template_note: Only generate Hindi queries for ingredients that have hindi_terms defined. These capture significant Tier 2/3 city search volume.
level_1_ingredient_queries.filter: Only generate if ingredient.compatible_formats includes the format
level_1_ingredient_queries.priority: Generate for popularity_rank <= 20 first, then remaining

level_2_benefit_queries.description: Benefit/claim × Format combinations. These capture category-level demand.

level_3_brand_queries.description: Brand × Hero Product combinations. Tracks brand-level market presence.
level_3_brand_queries.filter: Only top 5 hero products per brand by relevance

comparison_queries.description: Head-to-head comparisons for Google Trends comparison mode

matching_algorithm._description: How to match a user's parsed wish to stored trend data

step_1_parse_wish.input: Vitamin C serum for skin brightening

step_2_level_1_lookup.query: SELECT * FROM market_trends WHERE ingredient_tag = '{hero_ingredient}' AND query_level = 'ingredient' AND is_active = true AND fetched_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '35 days' ORDER BY current_score DESC LIMIT 5
step_2_level_1_lookup.fallback: If < 3 results, trigger on_demand fetch for ingredient × format queries

step_3_level_2_lookup.description: Find competing approaches for the same benefit
step_3_level_2_lookup.query: SELECT * FROM market_trends WHERE benefit_tag = '{primary_benefit}' AND query_level IN ('ingredient', 'benefit') AND ingredient_tag != '{hero_ingredient}' AND is_active = true AND fetched_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '35 days' ORDER BY current_score DESC LIMIT 5
step_3_level_2_lookup.include_user_ingredient: Also fetch user's own ingredient trend to position it in the comparison

step_4_level_3_lookup.query_trends: SELECT * FROM market_trends WHERE ingredient_tag = '{hero_ingredient}' AND query_level = 'brand' AND is_active = true AND fetched_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '35 days' ORDER BY current_score DESC LIMIT 5
step_4_level_3_lookup.query_shopping: SELECT * FROM shopping_data WHERE ingredient_tag = '{hero_ingredient}' AND product_format = '{product_format}' AND fetched_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '35 days' LIMIT 1
step_4_level_3_lookup.combine: Merge Google Trends brand data with Google Shopping price data

output_structure.level_1_ingredient_trends: Top 5 queries with scores and growth %
output_structure.level_2_competing_approaches: Top 5 alternative approaches with user's ingredient highlighted
output_structure.insights: AI-generated insights based on the data

batch_job_pseudocode._description: High-level pseudocode for the monthly batch job

steps.name: Generate Query List
steps.action: For each ingredient in config: generate Level 1 queries (ingredient × compatible formats). For each benefit: generate Level 2 queries. For each brand: generate Level 3 queries (brand × hero products). Add comparison group queries.

steps.name: Deduplicate
steps.action: Remove duplicate queries (e.g., 'Niacinamide serum' might appear in both brightening and acne categories)

steps.name: Check Auto-Add from On-Demand
steps.action: SELECT query_text, COUNT(*) FROM on_demand_log WHERE triggered_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND auto_added_to_batch = false GROUP BY query_text HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3. Add these to the batch list.

steps.name: Batch Fetch — Trends
steps.action: For each query: call SerpAPI Google Trends (interest_over_time + related_queries + geo_map). Rate limit: 5 requests/second. Retry failed queries up to 3 times.

steps.name: Batch Fetch — Shopping
steps.action: For top 100 ingredient × format queries: call SerpAPI Google Shopping. Extract price ranges, top brands.

steps.name: Calculate Derived Metrics
steps.action: For each trend: calculate growth_pct_3m, growth_pct_6m, growth_pct_12m, trend_direction, peak_month, current_score.

steps.name: Store Results
steps.action: Insert into market_trends and shopping_data tables with fetch_source = 'batch'.

steps.name: Mark Auto-Added Queries
steps.action: UPDATE on_demand_log SET auto_added_to_batch = true, auto_added_at = NOW() WHERE query_text IN (newly added queries)

steps.name: Generate Report
steps.action: Log: total queries fetched, new queries added from on-demand, API calls used, errors, total cost estimate. Biggest movers (top 10 rising, top 10 declining).

trend_direction_rules._description: How to calculate trend_direction from interest_over_time data

level_1_ingredient_format.formula: ~105 active ingredients × ~5 avg compatible formats = ~525 queries

level_2_benefit_format.formula: ~27 benefits (including 5 new Ayurvedic) × ~4 format variations = ~108 queries

comparisons.formula: 14 comparison groups (including 7 new Ayurvedic) × ~3 comparison queries = ~42 queries

hindi_regional_terms.formula: ~40 ingredients with Hindi terms × ~2 Hindi queries each = ~80 queries
hindi_regional_terms.note: Hindi search terms capture significant Indian search volume not covered by English queries

total.headroom_note: Generous buffer allows for aggressive on-demand fetching without hitting limits
